# External collections

Selections from other open role collections, converted for Molfar: each role is split into a **prompt** and a **skill** (up to 10,000 characters each), tool-specific instructions are removed, and the roles are packed into `.zip` files you install via **Settings** → **Data archive** → **Restore from archive** (Molfar 2.0.4+).

**These are not CC0.** Each subfolder keeps the original license and names its source, version and authors. Use the roles under that license.

| Folder | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `agency-agents/` | [msitarzewski/agency-agents](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents) — The Agency, a collection of AI agent personalities | MIT |
